title: R4 upgrade-preview rail re-anchor branch (view_rail_on) has no test
detail: New conditional re-anchors the armed preview card into the playfield when the rail is on (Perkins r1 W2 fix). No *_test.odin references draw_upgrade_preview/view_rail_on; harness goldens pass preview only with rail off. The branch can regress silently.
recommended_fix: Extract the anchor decision into a pure proc (rect in, play_w/rail_on in, px/py out) and pin both legs in an @(test), mirroring settings_panel_rect_follows_the_playfield.

title: Resize re-apply of the rail (transition 2 of 3) and view_compute's play_w reset are unpinned
detail: The W5 test series pins rail transitions 1 (D-toggle) and 3 (settings dismissal) by its own numbering; grep finds no 'transition 2' test. Deleting the re-apply (or view_compute's play_w=win_w reset) fails no unit test; world slides under the rail after resize.
recommended_fix: Add a render-level @(test): view_set_rail(true) then view_compute, expect play_w == win_w. If feasible, factor the resize branch into a callable proc and pin the re-apply at app level.

title: Rail-on app camera threading (camera_update/zoom/pan/pullback) tested only at play_w == win_w
evidence:
v.off_x = f32(v.play_w)/2 - app.cam_wx * v.scale
--- app/pullback_test.odin:42 (the only App fixture feeding camera_update/effect_zoom/effect_pan/pullback_feed tests):
	rnd.view_compute(&app.view, 1280, 720, &app.cat.balance)
detail: Four app-layer sites (1732, 1804, 1865-1866, 1893) now pass play_w into camera math; every existing App fixture calls view_compute so play_w == win_w. No test runs these with the rail on, so reverting any one site to win_w stays green.
recommended_fix: Add an app-level rail-on leg: view_set_rail(true), then pin camera_update's off_x and one zoom/pan clamp against the shrunken playfield (the noc_toggle_test play_w assertion pattern).

title: Draw order (rail under top-band HUD) verified only manually; the overlay-pixels smoke cannot detect an order regression
detail: The ruled 'rail NEVER covers the top-band HUD cards' is implemented purely by draw order in app/main.odin. The smoke diff draws both frames in the same order, so order cancels; only the KYLE capture (the spec's designated visual acceptance) covers it. An app-side reorder fails no gate.
recommended_fix: Accept as KYLE-gated per spec, or add a blessed D-on pixel golden (harness verb comparison) so an app draw-order regression fails CI.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (zero-drift: 48/48 harness gate + drift-rejection negative test + noc_toggle boot/toggle/dismissal play_w pins). P1 ~82%: rail geometry, wheel policy, ladder, width/rows/caps/column math, camera_fit, settings rect, crisis clamp fully pinned; rail-on app camera threading partial, resize re-apply and preview re-anchor unpinned. Overall >=80%.
recommended_fix: Land the three pins above (rail-on camera leg, view_compute play_w reset, preview anchor extraction) to lift P1 >=90%; the draw-order note is optional. That raises the gate to PASS.
